## User story

As an operator, I want an expired session to ask me to confirm my passkey again, so that I can keep working.

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- Numbered 1, 2, 3... -->

1. When the session has expired, the next company-management action shows the re-authentication dialog.
2. The session endpoint answers 401 after the session has expired.

## Area

<!-- One area slug. -->

auth

## Roles involved

- operator

## Out of scope

- None.

## Links

- None.
